## 1. Dimensions whose evidence is thin / claim-based → re-run warranted

**design (scored 6.6) — re-run, almost certainly inflated.** The prior blind panel put design at 4.7 ("still worst: no perceptual judge, evidence gate accepts placeholder screenshots"). Nothing has landed to justify +1.9: `apple-grade-design-gate.sh` contains zero image/PNG/pixel/screenshot content check (grep for `screenshot|placeholder|image|png|byte|width|height` returns nothing), and `field-runs/` contains no rendered screenshots at all. A 6.6 with no perceptual judge and a gate that still can't distinguish a real screenshot from a 0-byte placeholder is a score without a cited basis — discard and re-run against the gate source.

**oneshot (scored 5.7) — re-run with a trace-cited basis.** The claim "vague prompt → enterprise-grade app, evidence in field-runs" is contradicted by the actual traces: `walteur.js` documents a Discover phase (line 20, ceremony flags lines 371-373) but the first `emitSpan` in every `field-runs/*/walteur-kit/run-trace.jsonl` is Self-Heal/Scope/Think (walteur.js:303/311/405) — no `phase:'Discover'` span is ever emitted. And every ship in `SHIPPED.md` (lines 55/85/100/115/130) is `verified local — NOT public, no external URL`; the external template row (line 31) is still an empty `<https://…>` placeholder. The dimension must be scored against what the trace proves ran, not what the prose describes.

**memory (scored 6.3) — re-run demanding applied-lesson evidence.** `walteur-kit/memory/lessons.jsonl` has 10 real lessons, but every one carries `helpful:0, applied:0, invalidated_at:null` — nothing has ever been recalled or applied. "Provably learns from mistakes" (rubric 10/10) is unsupported: capture works, recall/apply is unproven. A 6.3 rests on the capture half only.
